items.question: Under which Ministry of Finance Ministerial Decision of 2025 is the UAE Electronic Invoicing System governed? Give the decision number.
items.fact: Electronic Invoicing System governed by Ministerial Decision No. 243 of 2025

items.question: Does the UAE VAT law (Federal Decree Law No. 8 of 2017) recognise electronic tax invoices as valid?
items.gold: Yes, it recognises tax invoices in written and/or electronic form.
items.fact: UAE VAT law recognises electronic tax invoices alongside written ones
